scope: Prevent strict ARCALIGNEDTEXT DXF output from silently accepting only a numeric prefix of a retained D2T string. Preserve the existing prefix behavior of the read-only text-height approximation.

changes: Added DxfNumeric::parseFiniteToken, which requires the parsed numeric token to consume the entire std::string except surrounding ASCII whitespace, rejects embedded-NUL suffixes, non-finite values, overflow and underflow-to-zero, and leaves the caller's output value unchanged on refusal.
Strict ARCALIGNEDTEXT DXF writing now uses complete-token parsing; applyArcApproximation retains parseFinitePrefix for its existing tolerant projection behavior.

Extended generated adapter refusal/retry coverage for all six D2T fields in ASCII and Binary DXF with values such as 2.25trailing. Each refusal preserves the existing destination and caller model; correction through the same adapter succeeds and typed readback matches.

Added direct numeric controls for surrounding whitespace, existing C-locale hexadecimal strtod compatibility, trailing text, embedded NUL, non-finite/overflow/underflow values, output preservation, and representable subnormal acceptance.
implementation.lexicalBoundary: This guards against prefix truncation only. It does not establish Autodesk's or all producers' complete ARCALIGNEDTEXT D2T lexical grammar; the existing strtod token syntax remains accepted.
implementation.fixturePolicy: All new cases are generated in memory or under the test temporary directory. No DWG/DXF fixture was added.

validation.initialFailure: The first direct numeric run exposed that a C-string terminator check could accept a std::string with bytes after an embedded NUL. The helper was corrected to compare the parse end against the string's actual byte limit; all focused selectors then passed.
validation.workspaceNote: Tests ran on the integrated worktree with other in-progress changes; source hashes identify only this slice.

binding.commitState: Included in the D2T precision/range/full-token implementation slice.

limitations: Generated conversion and rollback evidence only; no physical ARCALIGNEDTEXT producer or independent semantic/native consumer was exercised.
The guard does not define the producer's numeric lexical grammar or establish source-to-output fidelity for a physical DWG.
No DWG/DXF, FreeCAD, LibreCAD, LibreCAD_3, or general ARCALIGNEDTEXT support claim is promoted.
